title: 2176. Reverse an Array Using Pointers
description:
everse the array by swapping elements using pointers.
Print the reversed array.
Input Description:
First line contains an integer N.
Second line contains N space-separated integers.
Constraints:
1 ≤ N ≤ 1000
-10⁶ ≤ Array elements ≤ 10⁶
Output Description:
Print the array elements in reverse order, separated by spaces
